load_glb_motion: create a python module to load a GLB file and extract its animation motion data using GLB.Create(path).LoadMotion()
parse_glb_meshes: build a python script to parse all meshes from a GLB file and print vertex and triangle counts
extract_glb_skin_data: create a function to extract skin joint indices, weights, and inverse bind matrices from a GLB file
parse_glb_accessor: build a python module to parse raw binary data from a glTF accessor into a numpy array
debug_glb_structure: run a python script to print debug info about a GLB file including meshes, joints, and skin data
